name: Nebesnye tjagi
source: A young blogger - intellectual Dmitry Larin on the heyday of the Russian Internet hides eight cards in the northern capital of Russia. Rumour has it that if you collect them all, you can get a geotag with the location of Dmitry's secret lyrics for Versus-Battle. Another young connoisseur of culture, Evgeny Sokolovsky, goes in search of the "tablets", but finds something more on the way
